configure_sample_packing: configure an SFTConfig to enable packed, padding-free training batches
enable_sample_packing: enable runtime packed batch support on an existing Unsloth model and trainer
build_xformers_block_causal_mask: build an xFormers block-diagonal causal attention mask from packed sequence lengths
build_sdpa_packed_attention_mask: build a scaled-dot-product attention mask for packed sequences with optional sliding window
mask_packed_sequence_boundaries: mask final tokens of packed samples in shift_labels so cross-entropy ignores boundaries
